pathParams.name: node
pathParams.description: Only run if executed on this node.

params.name: all
params.description: Backup all known guest systems on this host.

params.name: bwlimit
params.description: Limit I/O bandwidth (in KiB/s).

params.name: compress
params.description: Compress dump file.

params.name: dumpdir
params.description: Store resulting files to specified directory.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Exclude specified guest systems (assumes --all)

params.name: exclude-path
params.description: Exclude certain files/directories (shell globs). Paths starting with '/' are anchored to the container's root, other paths match relative to each subdirectory.

params.name: fleecing
params.description: Options for backup fleecing (VM only).

params.name: ionice
params.description: Set IO priority when using the BFQ scheduler. For snapshot and suspend mode backups of VMs, this only affects the compressor. A value of 8 means the idle priority is used, otherwise the best-effort priority is used with the specified value.

params.name: job-id
params.description: The ID of the backup job. If set, the 'backup-job' metadata field of the backup notification will be set to this value. Only root@pam can set this parameter.

params.name: lockwait
params.description: Maximal time to wait for the global lock (minutes).

params.name: mailnotification
params.description: Deprecated: use notification targets/matchers instead. Specify when to send a notification mail

params.name: mailto
params.description: Deprecated: Use notification targets/matchers instead. Comma-separated list of email addresses or users that should receive email notifications.

params.name: mode
params.description: Backup mode.

params.name: notes-template
params.description: Template string for generating notes for the backup(s). It can contain variables which will be replaced by their values. Currently supported are {{cluster}}, {{guestname}}, {{node}}, and {{vmid}}, but more might be added in the future. Needs to be a single line, newline and backslash need to be escaped as '\n' and '\\' respectively.

params.name: notification-mode
params.description: Determine which notification system to use. If set to 'legacy-sendmail', vzdump will consider the mailto/mailnotification parameters and send emails to the specified address(es) via the 'sendmail' command. If set to 'notification-system', a notification will be sent via PVE's notification system, and the mailto and mailnotification will be ignored. If set to 'auto' (default setting), an email will be sent if mailto is set, and the notification system will be used if not.

params.name: pbs-change-detection-mode
params.description: PBS mode used to detect file changes and switch encoding format for container backups.

params.name: performance
params.description: Other performance-related settings.

params.name: pigz
params.description: Use pigz instead of gzip when N>0. N=1 uses half of cores, N>1 uses N as thread count.

params.name: pool
params.description: Backup all known guest systems included in the specified pool.

params.name: protected
params.description: If true, mark backup(s) as protected.

params.name: prune-backups
params.description: Use these retention options instead of those from the storage configuration.

params.name: quiet
params.description: Be quiet.

params.name: remove
params.description: Prune older backups according to 'prune-backups'.

params.name: script
params.description: Use specified hook script.

params.name: stdexcludes
params.description: Exclude temporary files and logs.

params.name: stdout
params.description: Write tar to stdout, not to a file.

params.name: stop
params.description: Stop running backup jobs on this host.

params.name: stopwait
params.description: Maximal time to wait until a guest system is stopped (minutes).

params.name: storage
params.description: Store resulting file to this storage.

params.name: tmpdir
params.description: Store temporary files to specified directory.

params.name: vmid
params.description: The ID of the guest system you want to backup.

params.name: zstd
params.description: Zstd threads. N=0 uses half of the available cores, if N is set to a value bigger than 0, N is used as thread count.

permissions.description: The user needs 'VM.Backup' permissions on any VM, and 'Datastore.AllocateSpace' on the backup storage (and fleecing storage when fleecing is used). The 'tmpdir', 'dumpdir', 'script' and 'job-id' parameters are restricted to the 'root@pam' user. The 'prune-backups' setting requires 'Datastore.Allocate' on the backup storage. The 'bwlimit', 'performance' and 'ionice' parameters require 'Sys.Modify' on '/'.
